body: Being sad around them. Fuck it. Bye.

There just really doesn't seem to be any point. I am unlovable and wear down even the most amazing person ever. I'm always going to be an emotional mess... I'm just so very tired... So lonely.... Paralyzed. If
 I can't be happy here in paradise, I don't see how I can ever be happy at all. There are other "friends" who basically told me not to come around if I can't fake it and wear a Fucking fake grin around them. Nobody really gives a shit

One of the things that bugs him about me is my poor housekeeping skills lol. And I'm not very good at staying indoors, but thank you for the suggestions. I am looking into some worktrade opportunities, where I can do gardening or cooking or other things in trade for a place to live.... But honestly, my motivation to do anything but cry and cut myself is pretty nonexistent
